Methodology: Lasso regression (α=0.9, 10-year window) maps 13 factor/style ETF ratios vs SPY to each FX rate. Residual = (actual − model) / actual × 100. Positive residual → currency overvalued relative to factor signals; negative → undervalued.
Factors: MTUM (Momentum), SPHB (High Beta), IWC (Micro Cap), IVW (LG Growth), IJT (SC Growth), IJR (Small Cap), IJS (SC Value), IJK (MC Growth), QUAL (Quality), IJJ (MC Value), VYM (High Div), IVE (LG Value), USMV (Min Vol).

AI Commentary · google/gemma-4-31B-it · 2026-07-06 21:59 UTC
Value and high-dividend factors proxy global risk appetite and real yield differentials; their strength typically signals a "risk-on" environment that supports emerging market currencies like BRL. The -7.6% residual indicates USDBRL is trading significantly below its factor-implied fair value, suggesting the Real is fundamentally overvalued or currently benefiting from idiosyncratic local tailwinds not captured by global equity style rotations.
